scientificBoundaries: Fictional two-species illustrative model, not a reconstruction or forecast of the Galapagos.
Fixed source pool and fixed neighboring starting cohorts; repeated draws do not represent independent source populations or real island samples.
Founder sampling and later reproduction both contribute to the spread; the study does not isolate a unique causal decomposition.
Matching the initial private breeding seed does not guarantee matching later draws when dispersal changes decisions.
H describes one neutral two-letter marker, not observed heterozygosity or genome-wide diversity.
Means and observed ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals, significance tests or guaranteed effects.
Copy contributions come from recorded inheritance; arrival counts and G0 ancestry describe different quantities.
Model settings, actual outcomes and source population/RNG remain unchanged. No generated scientific rules or fabricated outcomes are used.
